clips.title: Launch title
clips.alt: A white title card. A wordmark rises into a masked reveal, an accent rule draws in beneath it, the card holds, then fades out.
clips.prompt: A 14s launch title on a white canvas. The wordmark rises into a masked reveal, an accent rule draws in beneath it, the card holds for 2s, then fades out and lifts. Hairline rules top and bottom, one accent, no decoration.

clips.title: Kinetic type
clips.alt: Six words arrive one at a time on a black canvas, one word per line, alternating white and accent, then exit in reverse.
clips.prompt: Kinetic type on a black canvas. Six words, one word per line, each arriving on its own with a masked reveal, staggered 90ms, cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1), no bounce. Every second word is the accent colour. The words exit in reverse order.

clips.title: Product loop
clips.alt: Four pipeline stages fill in sequence, each with a progress bar, then a closing card that reads four stages, one file.
clips.prompt: A 21s product loop. Four stages fill in sequence, staggered 90ms, each with its own progress bar and percentage. Then the finished frame: a stat panel and a rule. Then a closing card that reads "Four stages. One file." One accent, 8px rhythm.

clips.title: Footage + title
clips.alt: A dark moving source clip with a title sequence burned in over the top and a cut-and-overlay readout along the bottom.
clips.prompt: Cut the first 3s of the source clip, add a title card in our brand type at 0:03, hold over the footage, fade out at 0:14. Kicker above, headline, a source-in and out readout, and a cut + overlay line along the bottom.
clips.renderedWith: Motion Master skills + the Montage bridge cut/overlay timeline

note: Every clip here was rendered by the skills this product ships. The prompt is the product: it is shown, copyable, and can be pasted straight into ChatGPT with the plugin installed. The source footage in footage-title is a generated stand-in, not customer footage.
